claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars are being held at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood in Los Angeles, California.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony is scheduled for Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The Dolby Theatre is a 2001-established home on Hollywood Boulevard.
The Dolby Theatre was formerly Kodak Theatre.
The Dolby Theatre is located at 6801 Hollywood Blvd, Hollywood, CA 90028.
The Dolby Theatre has hosted the Oscars since 2001.
The Dolby Theatre is contracted to host the Oscars through 2028.
The Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel hosted the first Oscars ceremony.
